# Frame Talk

> Autonomous multimodal screen-to-podcast production engine. Turn silent developer screencasts into engaging, perfectly synchronized two-host podcast walkthrough videos using Gemini 3.7 Flash and Chronos timeline stretching.

Frame Talk pairs **Gemini 3.7 Flash** multimodal video vision with the **Chronos Dynamic Freeze-Hold Engine**. Unlike text-only podcast synthesizers that are blind to UI actions, Frame Talk anchors spoken dialogue directly to video pixels, holding and freezing frames when discussions go deep to guarantee 100% video-audio lockstep.

## AI Agent Capabilities & Workflow

Autonomous AI agents can invoke Frame Talk entirely from the backend REST API via a 6-stage pipeline:

1. **Asset Ingestion & Probe**: Upload video (.mp4/.webm) and documentation (README.md). Check optimistic cache for instant replay.
2. **Multimodal Visual Scene Analysis**: Dispatches `IngestionAgent` with Gemini 3.7 Flash to segment video into timestamped UI action scenes with vision-grounding verification scorecards.
3. **Dialogue Scriptwriting & QA Pacing**: Dispatches `ScriptwriterAgent` to craft natural conversation between two hosts (Mark & Sarah) anchored to UI scenes, audited by `QAAgent`.
4. **Speech Synthesis & Chronos Alignment**: Calls `AudioSynthEngine` (Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview) generating 24kHz PCM audio. The `ChronosEngine` meters speech duration against visual scene duration and inserts frame-holds (`+300ms` buffer) whenever speech exceeds video length.
5. **Video Compilation**: Dispatches `CompilerAgent` to render a 1080p MP4 with baked-in frame freezes and dual-channel audio muxing via FFmpeg.
6. **Observability & Telemetry**: ClickHouse time-series event tracking, token count and dollar cost metering, and Grafana dashboard analytics.

- [User Statistics Aggregation](https://frame-talk.taskmind-ai.com/api/clickhouse/user-statistics): Multi-user funnel conversion and action distribution statistics.

## Core Architecture & Engine Models

- **Vision Ingestion**: `gemini-3.7-flash` (multimodal native token processing)
- **Dialogue Scriptwriting**: `gemini-3.7-flash` (conversational anchoring)
- **QA Script Audit**: `gemini-3.7-flash` (adherence, naturalness, coverage)
- **Speech Synthesis**: `gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview` (24kHz Mono Linear PCM, Puck & Kore voices)
- **Timeline Engine**: `ChronosEngine` (dynamic hold calculation: `required_freeze_ms = speech_ms - scene_ms + 300`)
- **Video Assembly**: `FFmpeg` (frame-accurate hold baking and PCM audio muxing)
- **Telemetry Store**: `ClickHouse` (asynchronous non-blocking event streaming)
- **Security & Privacy**: Zero PII storage, salted SHA-256 pseudonymization (`X-FrameTalk-User-Hash`), prompt injection guardrails.
